&Run
" (pronounced "and run") is the seventh single by American
indie pop
band,
Sir Sly
. The song was released as the fourth single from the band's second album,
Don't You Worry, Honey
, on June 30, 2017, via a
YouTube
video through
Interscope Records
.
[
1
]
The song was featured on the soundtrack to
FIFA 18
.
[
2
]
Music video
The music video for the track was released on December 7, 2017. The video features the band going through daily life preparing for the shooting of a music video, and examining sights for the video.
